# Atlas Retail Q2 Call

## Store expansion

Atlas plans to open twenty-four new stores next year. Most locations will serve smaller regional cities.

## Online returns

Customers can now return web orders through parcel lockers. The service does not require a visit to a physical store.

## Labor costs

Warehouse automation offset higher hourly wages. Total fulfillment labor cost remained flat.
